title: Ravena — Jogadores
description: Detalhe por jogador da economia: ranking, anomalias e ficha. Mesma fonte do painel da economia (analytics.db). Mostra nome e telefone (decisão de produto: moeda de jogo; Grafana só por túnel ou com senha). O analytics.db guarda epoch em ms; o frser-sqlite-datasource lê colunas de tempo em segundos, por isso o / 1000 nos SELECT.

panels.title: Quem mais ganhou — ${moeda} (período selecionado)
panels.description: Os 25 que mais receberam de motivos de criação no período. Criado = motivos de criação (recompensas, prêmios, divórcio…); câmbio e transferências separados. Uma pessoa junta os IDs dela nas três fontes (LID resolvido pelo memory.db, telefone de 12 e 13 dígitos). Clique no nome para abrir o jogador. Petalitas: só saldo (Jardim sem extrato).

targets.queryText:
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT i.person, MAX(i.phone) AS phone, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.id_kind) AS tipos,
    COALESCE(MAX(i.name), (SELECT MAX(p.name) FROM players p JOIN identities j ON j.player_id = p.player_id WHERE j.person = i.person)) AS nome
  FROM identities i GROUP BY i.person
),
agg AS (
  SELECT i.person,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'creation' THEN d.amount_in - d.amount_out ELSE 0 END) AS criado,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'destruction' THEN d.amount_out - d.amount_in ELSE 0 END) AS destruido,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') THEN d.amount_in - d.amount_out ELSE 0 END) AS cambio,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'transfer' THEN d.amount_in - d.amount_out ELSE 0 END) AS transf,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind <> 'non_monetary' THEN d.amount_in - d.amount_out ELSE 0 END) AS liquido
  FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
  WHERE d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to
  GROUP BY i.person
),
top_reason AS (
  SELECT person, motivo FROM (
    SELECT i.person, COALESCE(l.label, d.reason) AS motivo,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.person ORDER BY SUM(d.amount_in) DESC) AS rn
    FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
    LEFT JOIN reason_labels l ON l.currency = d.currency AND l.reason = d.reason
    WHERE d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to AND d.kind = 'creation'
    GROUP BY i.person, d.reason) WHERE rn = 1
),
bal AS (
  SELECT i.person, SUM(p.balance) AS saldo FROM players p JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.currency = '${moeda}' GROUP BY i.person
),
massa AS (SELECT SUM(balance) AS m FROM players WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND balance > 0)
SELECT agg.person AS "Pessoa", COALESCE(pp.nome, '—') AS "Nome", CASE WHEN pp.phone IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || pp.phone WHEN pp.person LIKE 'tg:%' THEN 'Telegram ' || substr(pp.person, 4) WHEN pp.person LIKE 'lid:%' THEN 'LID ' || substr(pp.person, 5) ELSE pp.person END AS "Telefone / ID", pp.tipos AS "Tipo de ID",
  agg.criado AS "Criado", agg.destruido AS "Destruído", agg.cambio AS "Câmbio (líquido)", agg.transf AS "Transferências (líquido)",
  agg.liquido AS "Líquido", bal.saldo AS "Saldo atual", ROUND(100.0 * bal.saldo / NULLIF((SELECT m FROM massa), 0), 2) AS "% da massa",
  top_reason.motivo AS "Maior fonte"
FROM agg JOIN pp ON pp.person = agg.person
LEFT JOIN bal ON bal.person = agg.person LEFT JOIN top_reason ON top_reason.person = agg.person
ORDER BY agg.criado DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Anomalias: dias com criação acima de 10× a mediana — ${moeda} (período selecionado)
panels.description: Pessoa-dia em que alguém recebeu de motivos de criação 10× ou mais a mediana de quem recebeu algo naquele dia (dias com pelo menos 5 jogadores). Motivo dominante = o motivo que mais pesou no dia da pessoa. Ponto de partida para investigar: prêmio legítimo de evento também aparece aqui.

targets.queryText:
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT i.person, MAX(i.phone) AS phone, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.id_kind) AS tipos,
    COALESCE(MAX(i.name), (SELECT MAX(p.name) FROM players p JOIN identities j ON j.player_id = p.player_id WHERE j.person = i.person)) AS nome
  FROM identities i GROUP BY i.person
),
pd AS (
  SELECT d.day, i.person, SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) AS criado
  FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
  WHERE d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.kind = 'creation' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to
  GROUP BY d.day, i.person HAVING SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) > 0
),
ord AS (SELECT day, criado, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day ORDER BY criado) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY day) AS n FROM pd),
med AS (SELECT day, AVG(criado) AS mediana, MAX(n) AS n FROM ord WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY day),
dom AS (
  SELECT day, person, motivo, v FROM (
    SELECT d.day, i.person, COALESCE(l.label, d.reason) AS motivo, SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) AS v,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.day, i.person ORDER BY SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) DESC) AS rn
    FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
    LEFT JOIN reason_labels l ON l.currency = d.currency AND l.reason = d.reason
    WHERE d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.kind = 'creation' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to
    GROUP BY d.day, i.person, d.reason) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT pd.day / 1000 AS "Dia", pd.person AS "Pessoa", COALESCE(pp.nome, '—') AS "Nome", CASE WHEN pp.phone IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || pp.phone WHEN pp.person LIKE 'tg:%' THEN 'Telegram ' || substr(pp.person, 4) WHEN pp.person LIKE 'lid:%' THEN 'LID ' || substr(pp.person, 5) ELSE pp.person END AS "Telefone / ID",
  pd.criado AS "Criado no dia", ROUND(med.mediana) AS "Mediana do dia", ROUND(pd.criado / med.mediana, 1) AS "Vezes a mediana",
  dom.motivo AS "Motivo dominante", ROUND(100.0 * dom.v / pd.criado, 0) AS "% do dia", med.n AS "Jogadores no dia"
FROM pd JOIN med ON med.day = pd.day JOIN pp ON pp.person = pd.person
LEFT JOIN dom ON dom.day = pd.day AND dom.person = pd.person
WHERE med.n >= 5 AND med.mediana > 0 AND pd.criado >= 10 * med.mediana
ORDER BY "Vezes a mediana" DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Maiores saldos — ${moeda} (agora)
panels.description: Saldo atual por pessoa (somando os IDs dela), fatia da massa e variação desde o saldo de 7 dias atrás (fim do dia econômico).

targets.queryText:
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT i.person, MAX(i.phone) AS phone, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.id_kind) AS tipos,
    COALESCE(MAX(i.name), (SELECT MAX(p.name) FROM players p JOIN identities j ON j.player_id = p.player_id WHERE j.person = i.person)) AS nome
  FROM identities i GROUP BY i.person
),
bal AS (
  SELECT i.person, SUM(p.balance) AS saldo FROM players p JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.currency = '${moeda}' GROUP BY i.person
),
semana AS (
  SELECT i.person, SUM(b.balance) AS saldo FROM player_balance_daily b JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = b.player_id
  WHERE b.currency = '${moeda}' AND b.day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM player_balance_daily x WHERE x.currency = '${moeda}' AND x.day <= $__to - 604800000)
  GROUP BY i.person
),
massa AS (SELECT SUM(balance) AS m FROM players WHERE currency = '${moeda}' AND balance > 0)
SELECT bal.person AS "Pessoa", COALESCE(pp.nome, '—') AS "Nome", CASE WHEN pp.phone IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || pp.phone WHEN pp.person LIKE 'tg:%' THEN 'Telegram ' || substr(pp.person, 4) WHEN pp.person LIKE 'lid:%' THEN 'LID ' || substr(pp.person, 5) ELSE pp.person END AS "Telefone / ID", pp.tipos AS "Tipo de ID",
  bal.saldo AS "Saldo", ROUND(100.0 * bal.saldo / NULLIF((SELECT m FROM massa), 0), 2) AS "% da massa",
  bal.saldo - semana.saldo AS "Variação em 7 dias"
FROM bal JOIN pp ON pp.person = bal.person LEFT JOIN semana ON semana.person = bal.person
ORDER BY bal.saldo DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Encontrar jogador (busca por nome, telefone ou ID)
panels.description: Digite parte do nome, do telefone ou do ID no campo 'Buscar' no topo. Clique no nome para abrir o jogador.

targets.queryText:
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT i.person, MAX(i.phone) AS phone, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.id_kind) AS tipos,
    COALESCE(MAX(i.name), (SELECT MAX(p.name) FROM players p JOIN identities j ON j.player_id = p.player_id WHERE j.person = i.person)) AS nome
  FROM identities i GROUP BY i.person
),
bal AS (
  SELECT i.person,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'zinthos' THEN p.balance END) AS z, SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'runas' THEN p.balance END) AS r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'petalitas' THEN p.balance END) AS pt
  FROM players p JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY i.person
),
cmds AS (
  SELECT i.person, SUM(a.uses) AS u FROM player_activity_daily a JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = a.player_id
  WHERE a.day >= $__to - 604800000 AND a.day < $__to GROUP BY i.person
)
SELECT pp.person AS "Pessoa", COALESCE(pp.nome, '—') AS "Nome", CASE WHEN pp.phone IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || pp.phone WHEN pp.person LIKE 'tg:%' THEN 'Telegram ' || substr(pp.person, 4) WHEN pp.person LIKE 'lid:%' THEN 'LID ' || substr(pp.person, 5) ELSE pp.person END AS "Telefone / ID", pp.tipos AS "Tipo de ID",
  bal.z AS "Zinthos", bal.r AS "Runas", bal.pt AS "Petalitas", cmds.u AS "Comandos (7 dias)"
FROM pp LEFT JOIN bal ON bal.person = pp.person LEFT JOIN cmds ON cmds.person = pp.person
WHERE ${busca:sqlstring} = '' OR pp.nome LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%' OR pp.person LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%'
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities j WHERE j.person = pp.person AND j.player_id LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY COALESCE(bal.z, 0) + COALESCE(bal.r, 0) DESC LIMIT 50

WITH pp AS (
  SELECT i.person, MAX(i.phone) AS phone, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.id_kind) AS tipos,
    COALESCE(MAX(i.name), (SELECT MAX(p.name) FROM players p JOIN identities j ON j.player_id = p.player_id WHERE j.person = i.person)) AS nome
  FROM identities i GROUP BY i.person
),
bal AS (
  SELECT i.person,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'zinthos' THEN p.balance END) AS z, SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'runas' THEN p.balance END) AS r,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.currency = 'petalitas' THEN p.balance END) AS pt
  FROM players p JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY i.person
),
cmds AS (
  SELECT i.person, SUM(a.uses) AS u FROM player_activity_daily a JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = a.player_id
  WHERE a.day >= $__to - 604800000 AND a.day < $__to GROUP BY i.person
)
SELECT pp.person AS "Pessoa", COALESCE(pp.nome, '—') AS "Nome", CASE WHEN pp.phone IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || pp.phone WHEN pp.person LIKE 'tg:%' THEN 'Telegram ' || substr(pp.person, 4) WHEN pp.person LIKE 'lid:%' THEN 'LID ' || substr(pp.person, 5) ELSE pp.person END AS "Telefone / ID", pp.tipos AS "Tipo de ID",
  bal.z AS "Zinthos", bal.r AS "Runas", bal.pt AS "Petalitas", cmds.u AS "Comandos (7 dias)"
FROM pp LEFT JOIN bal ON bal.person = pp.person LEFT JOIN cmds ON cmds.person = pp.person
WHERE ${busca:sqlstring} = '' OR pp.nome LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%' OR pp.person LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%'
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities j WHERE j.person = pp.person AND j.player_id LIKE '%' || ${busca:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY COALESCE(bal.z, 0) + COALESCE(bal.r, 0) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Ficha do jogador
panels.description: Escolha o jogador clicando num nome das tabelas acima (ou digitando a pessoa no campo 'Jogador': telefone com 13 dígitos, tg:<id> ou lid:<id>). Período = seletor de tempo.

targets.queryText:
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT i.person, MAX(i.phone) AS phone, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.id_kind) AS tipos,
    COALESCE(MAX(i.name), (SELECT MAX(p.name) FROM players p JOIN identities j ON j.player_id = p.player_id WHERE j.person = i.person)) AS nome
  FROM identities i GROUP BY i.person
), cur(currency, nome, ordem) AS (VALUES ('zinthos', 'Zinthos', 1), ('petalitas', 'Petalitas', 2), ('runas', 'Runas', 3))
SELECT cur.nome AS "Moeda",
  (SELECT SUM(p.balance) FROM players p JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = p.player_id WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND p.currency = cur.currency) AS "Saldo atual",
  (SELECT SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = cur.currency AND d.kind = 'creation' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to) AS "Criado no período",
  (SELECT SUM(d.amount_out - d.amount_in) FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = cur.currency AND d.kind = 'destruction' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to) AS "Destruído no período",
  (SELECT SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = cur.currency AND d.kind IN ('exchange_in', 'exchange_out') AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to) AS "Câmbio (líquido)",
  (SELECT SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = cur.currency AND d.kind = 'transfer' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to) AS "Transferências (líquido)",
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(i.player_id || ' (' || i.id_kind || ')', ', ') FROM identities i
     WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND i.player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM players p WHERE p.currency = cur.currency
                                    UNION SELECT player_id FROM player_daily d WHERE d.currency = cur.currency)) AS "IDs nesta fonte",
  (SELECT COALESCE(pp.nome, '—') || ' · ' || CASE WHEN pp.phone IS NOT NULL THEN '+' || pp.phone ELSE pp.person END FROM pp WHERE pp.person = ${jogador:sqlstring}) AS "Quem"
FROM cur ORDER BY cur.ordem

panels.title: Saldo por dia — ${moeda} — jogador escolhido
panels.description: Saldo no fim de cada dia econômico (o dia corrente = agora). Petalitas: só desde a primeira carga.

targets.queryText:
SELECT b.day / 1000 AS time, SUM(b.balance) AS "Saldo no fim do dia"
FROM player_balance_daily b JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = b.player_id
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND b.currency = '${moeda}' AND b.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND b.day < $__to
GROUP BY b.day ORDER BY b.day
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT b.day / 1000 AS time, SUM(b.balance) AS "Saldo no fim do dia"
FROM player_balance_daily b JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = b.player_id
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND b.currency = '${moeda}' AND b.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND b.day < $__to
GROUP BY b.day ORDER BY b.day

panels.title: Fluxo por motivo e dia — ${moeda} — jogador escolhido
panels.description: Líquido (entrou − saiu) por motivo e dia econômico.

targets.queryText:
SELECT d.day / 1000 AS time, COALESCE(l.label, d.reason) AS "Motivo", SUM(d.amount_in - d.amount_out) AS "Líquido"
FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN reason_labels l ON l.currency = d.currency AND l.reason = d.reason
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.kind <> 'non_monetary' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to
GROUP BY d.day, d.reason ORDER BY d.day

GROUP BY d.day, d.reason ORDER BY d.day

targets.queryText:
SELECT d.day / 1000 AS "Dia", COALESCE(l.label, d.reason) AS "Motivo", CASE d.kind WHEN 'creation' THEN 'Criação' WHEN 'destruction' THEN 'Destruição'
    WHEN 'transfer' THEN 'Transferência' WHEN 'exchange_in' THEN 'Câmbio (entrada)'
    WHEN 'exchange_out' THEN 'Câmbio (saída)' WHEN 'non_monetary' THEN 'Fora do dinheiro'
    ELSE 'Sem mapeamento' END AS "Tipo",
  SUM(d.amount_in) AS "Entrou", SUM(d.amount_out) AS "Saiu", SUM(d.tx_count) AS "Transações"
FROM player_daily d JOIN identities i ON i.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN reason_labels l ON l.currency = d.currency AND l.reason = d.reason
WHERE i.person = ${jogador:sqlstring} AND d.currency = '${moeda}' AND d.day >= (($__from - 25200000) / 86400000) * 86400000 + 25200000 AND d.day < $__to
GROUP BY d.day, d.reason ORDER BY d.day DESC, SUM(d.amount_in) + SUM(d.amount_out) DESC
